title: SourceManifest
description: Authoritative metadata about one underlying legal/administrative source document. This is the audit root everything else points back to.

source_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this source, referenced by ProcedureRecord.source_id and ProcedureFragment.source_id.

title.description: Human-readable title of the source document (e.g. the decree/circular name).

publishing_authority.description: The government body or authority that issued this source.

reference_url.description: Canonical URL or reference locator for the original source, if available.

review_status.description: Whether this source has passed review. Unreviewed material must never be silently treated as authoritative (Section 7).

effective_date.description: Date this source's content became legally effective.

superseded_by.description: source_id of the source that replaces this one, if this version has been superseded. Null if this is current.

version.description: Version label for this source (e.g. a document revision number).

content_hash.description: Hash of the full source content, used to detect drift between what was indexed and what currently exists.

ingested_at.description: Timestamp this source was pulled into a corpus snapshot.
